params._newEngine: Address of the new game engine

setGauntletSize(uint8).details: The game must be disabled via `setGameEnabled(false)` before calling this function.      Disabling the game automatically clears the queue.

setMaxDefaultPlayerSubstituteId(uint32).details: Owner must ensure this ID corresponds to an existing, valid player in the `DefaultPlayer` contract.      Must be within the range [1, 2000].

params._maxId: The highest default player ID to consider for substitution.

params.newMinTime: The new minimum time in seconds.

setPlayerContract(address).details: Only callable by the contract owner

params._newContract: Address of the new player contract

tryStartGauntlet().details: Callable by anyone (e.g., Gelato Automation). Randomly selects N players from the queue using      pseudo-randomness derived from block variables. Uses swap-and-pop to remove selected players efficiently.      WARNING: Random selection and removal can be more gas-intensive than FIFO, especially with large queues.

withdrawFromQueue(uint32).details: Uses swap-and-pop to maintain queue integrity.

currentGauntletSize().notice: Current number of participants required to start a Gauntlet (4, 8, 16, or 32).

fulfillRandomness(uint256,bytes).notice: Callback function used by Gelato VRF to return the random number. The randomness is derived by hashing the provided randomness with the request ID.

gameEngine().notice: Interface to the game engine contract

gauntlets(uint256).notice: Maps Gauntlet IDs to their detailed `Gauntlet` struct data.

getGauntletData(uint256).notice: Returns the full data structure for a specific Gauntlet run.

getPlayerLoadoutFromQueue(uint32).notice: Returns the loadout for a player from the queue.

getQueueSize().notice: Returns the current number of players waiting in the queue.

maxDefaultPlayerSubstituteId().notice: The maximum ID used when randomly substituting retired players with defaults.

nextGauntletId().notice: Counter for assigning unique Gauntlet IDs.

playerCurrentGauntlet(uint32).notice: If status is IN_GAUNTLET, maps player ID to the `gauntletId` they are participating in.

playerIndexInQueue(uint32).notice: Maps player IDs to their (1-based) index within the `queueIndex` array for O(1) lookup during removal. 0 if not in queue.

playerStatus(uint32).notice: Tracks the current status (NONE, QUEUED, IN_GAUNTLET) of a player.

queueForGauntlet((uint32,(uint32,uint16).notice: Allows a player owner to join the Gauntlet queue with a specific loadout.

queueIndex(uint256).notice: Array containing the IDs of players currently in the queue. Order matters for swap-and-pop removal.

recoverTimedOutVRF(uint256).notice: Allows anyone to trigger recovery for a timed-out Gauntlet.

registrationQueue(uint32).notice: Stores loadout data for players currently in the queue.

requestToGauntletId(uint256).notice: Maps VRF request IDs back to their corresponding Gauntlet ID.

setDefaultPlayerContract(address).notice: Updates the address of the `DefaultPlayer` contract.

setGameEnabled(bool).notice: Toggles the ability for players to queue for Gauntlets.

setGameEngine(address).notice: Sets a new game engine address

setGauntletSize(uint8).notice: Sets the number of participants required to start a gauntlet (4, 8, 16, or 32).

setMaxDefaultPlayerSubstituteId(uint32).notice: Sets the maximum ID used for default player substitutions during VRF fulfillment.

setMinTimeBetweenGauntlets(uint256).notice: Sets the minimum time required between starting gauntlets.

setOperator(address).notice: Sets the Gelato VRF operator address.

setPlayerContract(address).notice: Sets a new player contract address

tryStartGauntlet().notice: Attempts to start a new Gauntlet if enough time has passed and the queue has enough players.

withdrawFromQueue(uint32).notice: Allows a player owner to withdraw their player from the queue before a Gauntlet starts.
